scope: Local Linux overlay; real tsc watch and watchfiles + markdown-it-py; no MkDocs/Vite runtime claim
oracle: Exact relative output path set and SHA-256 bytes; identity normalization; fresh one-shot build of final copied sources
latency: first sample in final matching suffix, lower bounded by edit completion; not defined for no-op controls or stale outcomes
noise: build attempts in output-neutral temporary-file episodes; extra builds during relevant bursts are not called unnecessary
stop_rule: fixed job list; infrastructure failures retained; no outcome-adaptive repetition
pilot_disclosure: The nine pilot observations were inspected before this main protocol was frozen. Main results are new executions. The size-changing inplace replay was made distinct from same_size before main freeze.
inference: Frequencies over six executions per cell on one host; no independent-project or population inference; final staleness is relative to the 1.5 s obligation, not proof of permanent loss.
hypothesis: Native notification and existing relevance filters may suffice for ordinary edits. Metadata polling may miss restored-stat writes. Content rescan is an established coverage/cost control, not a novel watcher.
provenance: This local alternative follows unsuccessful MkDocs/Vite dependency retrieval. No historical upstream case is counted as locally replayed.
